cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1-D5 in Rust. (1) audit.rs KINDS gains "knowledge-upkeep" and "verify-upkeep" (array length 18); update every test or help text that lists the closed set (rg the existing kind "dissent-deferral" to find them). (2) New verb group `bee upkeep due`, modeled on verbs/tmp_group.rs (routing, g_prelude, json flag) and on knowledge report's --root handling (g_prelude_at). Flags: --kind knowledge|verify (other value refuses, naming both), --root <path>. Register it in generated/registry_payload.json with a full description (hand-edited; tests/registry_contracts.rs pins the shape) so `bee upkeep due --help` and the CLI-shape guard know it. (3) Output JSON exactly: {schema:"bee-upkeep-due/v1", any_due:bool, items:[{kind, skill:"bee-knowledge-upkeep"|"bee-verify-upkeep", invoke:"/bee-knowledge-upkeep"|"/bee-verify-upkeep", present:bool, due:bool, reasons:[{code, detail}], info:[{code, detail}], last_run:{at, outcome, note}|null}]}. last_run = newest .bee/audit.jsonl row of kind knowledge-upkeep / verify-upkeep; outcome = first word of the note. Text output: one line per item (kind, due or not due, reason codes) then the invoke command when due. Exit 0 when no reported item is due, 10 when any is; errors keep their normal non-zero codes. (4) Knowledge item: present = docs/knowledge holds a bundle (root index.md exists). Not present => due false, no reasons. Reasons: never_run (no row); release_since_last_run (newest tag matching v* by creator date, read with git for-each-ref, newer than last_run.at; skip silently when not a git repo or no tag); reported_wrong (concepts in the knowledge report knowledge_wrong data whose reporting cell was capped after last_run.at, or all when never run; detail names count and up to 3 paths; you may extend the report builder to expose per-cell capped time); orphan (knowledge check freshness orphan > 0); suspect_loaded (a concept graded suspect in freshness whose loads in knowledge_used.loaded >= 5; one const SUSPECT_LOAD_MIN = 5). Loaded-never-used concepts with loads >= 5 go to info with code loaded_never_used and never set due. Call the existing builders in-process; never spawn bee. (5) Verify item: present = .bee/verify/verify-app/SKILL.md exists; reasons never_run and release_since_last_run only. (6) Strictly read-only: no write to any file, no timing log. Tests (behavior, temp-dir stores): no bundle and no verify skill => exit 0, both present false; bundle with no audit row => knowledge due with never_run, exit 10; a knowledge-upkeep row newer than every tag and no other signal => not due; --kind verify narrows items to one; bad --kind refuses; audit log accepts the two new kinds. No code comments. Proof: cargo test filtered to the new and touched modules, plus registry_contracts and the audit tests; quote the counts.
